title: golden_resolution event
description: Emitted for every section where golden matching is attempted during generation. TC-OBS-001.

match_level.description: Which matching level succeeded, or miss if no golden was found.

matched_heading.description: The golden section heading that matched. Empty string on miss.

query_heading.description: The section heading that was queried.

page_role.description: Page role used for golden lookup.

page_slug.description: Slug of the page being generated.

section_index.description: 0-based index of the section within the page.

variant.description: Golden variant used for lookup (e.g. standard, minimal).

jaccard_score.description: Jaccard similarity score. 0.0 unless match_level is jaccard.

golden_page_path.description: Path to the golden file that matched. Empty string on miss.

golden_word_count.description: Word count of the matched golden section. 0 on miss.

has_structural_spec.description: Whether a GoldenBlockSpec was derivable from the matched section.

is_heal_mode.description: Whether this section was in heal/regeneration mode.

heal_attempt.description: Heal attempt number (0 if not in heal mode).
